search_window.basis: Prior verified Food Line ledger heartbeat completed at 07:46:10.614 PST. Only fresh incidents or fresh official notices since that instant qualify; search-index/crawl dates and scheduled future service changes alone do not prove new events.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary Food Line recall; production nationwide collection remains authoritative.
target_classes: Loss/closure/fire/disaster involving the only, sole, last, or full-service grocery store in a community
Emergency food distribution cancelled/suspended due to storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry/food bank closure or material food-access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate consequences

coverage_notes.observation: All 12 targeted searches returned usable results. No independently verifiable newly announced or newly occurring qualifying disruption within the verified hourly window was identified. Recency-ranked results predominantly concerned 2025 SNAP shutdown articles and September 2026 grocery/fire/weather incidents. The October 31 Provo closure appears in searches but was documented in earlier watches.

coverage_notes.limitations: Bounded keyword search is not exhaustive. Newly posted local provider notices may not yet be indexed. No search or source failure was identified; a nonessential GitHub HTML page fetch was unavailable, but GitHub connector reads and compare succeeded.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approvals, publication, schedule modifications or task disablement; production collection remains authoritative.
